findings.summary: read_humidity_real skips sensor_sample_fetch and relies on the SDK calling read_temperature_real first in every publish cycle. If SDK callback dispatch order is not guaranteed to match insertion order, the humidity reading draws on the driver's zero-initialised or previous-cycle buffer without triggering the NAN guard — a silent bad value. Safer fix: store humidity in a static inside read_temperature_real and return it from read_humidity_real, or call sensor_sample_fetch inside read_humidity_real.

Both read_temperature_real and read_humidity_real ignore the int returned by sensor_channel_get. On an error return the struct sensor_value is uninitialised and sensor_value_to_double returns a garbage double instead of NAN. Fix: check the return value and return (double)NAN on failure.
